title: Drain stop, wait, restart and resume are hand-written shell commands; self-matching kills and unverified resumes recur

brief.question: Should Athena get its own stop, status and restart commands for the drain?
brief.if_yes: Athena tracks the running drain itself and rebuilds before restarting. Hand-typed process kills go away.
brief.if_no: The the person running Athena keeps typing kill and restart commands by hand. Idle hours and old-build batches keep happening.
brief.cost: One medium job: a new command, a lock file and tests, roughly one to two hours of work.
brief.recommendation: Yes: the same hand mistake has happened three times and has cost idle hours.
